series.name: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator
series.notes: Operating LED rows (6) + Communication LED rows (7) = 13 unnumbered LED states. Codes are synthetic LED labels, NOT Fronius state-code numbers. Differences vs SERIES 4 (Primo GEN24): the Symo Communication LED additionally shows blue = network connection active, '/ Flash blue' = update in progress, and white = service message present; and the yellow-flash Operating LED is worded 'The inverter displays an error. The inverter is operating correctly.' Do not merge this table with SERIES 4.

title.ur: Operating LED sabit hara: normal chal raha hai

meaning.ur: Inverter theek se kaam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Normal grid power feed operation on this three-phase unit.
causes.ur: Is three-phase unit par normal grid feed-in chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Nothing to do - healthy state.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi - healthy state.

solutions.en: If the customer reports low yield, read the per-phase energy figures rather than the LED, since three-phase imbalance is invisible on the LED.
solutions.ur: Agar customer kam yield ki shikayat kare to LED ke bajaye har phase ki energy figures padhein, kyunke three-phase imbalance LED se nazar nahi aati.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED green flashing: grid checks
title.ur: Operating LED hara flash: grid checks chal rahe hain

meaning.en: The inverter is performing the grid checks required by the applicable standards for grid power feed operation.
meaning.ur: Inverter grid power feed operation ke liye applicable standards ke mutabiq grid checks kar raha hai.

causes.en: Startup or reconnection grid monitoring time running; voltage and frequency must both be in range.
causes.ur: Startup ya reconnection ka grid monitoring time chal raha hai; voltage aur frequency dono range mein hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Wait for the monitoring time to expire; the inverter reconnects automatically afterwards.
solutions.ur: Monitoring time poora hone dein; uske baad inverter khud reconnect ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it never stops, measure voltage and frequency on all three phases at the AC terminals with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Agar ye chalta hi rahe to clamp meter se AC terminals par teenon phases ka voltage aur frequency measure karein.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED yellow: standby, idle or not configured
title.ur: Operating LED sabit peela: standby, idle ya configure nahi

meaning.en: The inverter is on standby, is not operating (e.g. no energy fed into the grid at night), or is not configured.
meaning.ur: Inverter standby par hai, chal nahi raha (jaise raat ko grid mein koi energy feed nahi), ya configure nahi hua.

causes.en: No energy fed into the grid at night - normal standby state.
causes.ur: Raat ko grid mein koi energy feed nahi ho rahi - normal standby state.

causes.en: Setup wizard / commissioning not completed on this unit.
causes.ur: Is unit par setup wizard ya commissioning complete nahi hui.

solutions.en: Confirm the DC disconnector is closed and the PV generator is producing before assuming a fault.
solutions.ur: Fault ka shak karne se pehle confirm karein ke DC disconnector band hai aur PV generator bana raha hai.

solutions.en: During daylight, log into the Fronius Solar.start app as Technician and complete the setup wizard.
solutions.ur: Dopahar mein, Fronius Solar.start app mein Technician se login karke setup wizard poora karein.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED yellow flashing: error, inverter still running
title.ur: Operating LED peela flash: error, inverter chalta hai

meaning.en: The inverter displays an error but continues to operate correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter error dikha raha hai lekin sahi se kaam karta raha hai.

causes.en: A warning-class state code is active while the inverter keeps producing.
causes.ur: Warning class ka state code active hai aur inverter bana raha hai.

causes.en: An isolation or arc-warning condition that Fronius logs but does not shut down for.
causes.ur: Aisi isolation ya arc-warning condition jo Fronius log karta hai lekin shutdown nahi karta.

solutions.en: Read the exact state code from System > Event Log, the Notifications user menu, or Solar.web - the LED colour does not identify the code.
solutions.ur: System > Event Log, Notifications user menu ya Solar.web se exact state code padhein - LED ka rang code identify nahi karta.

solutions.en: Record the code and timestamp before resetting anything so the event history survives.
solutions.ur: Kuch reset karne se pehle code aur timestamp note karein taake event history bachi rahe.

solutions.en: If a warning repeats every day, treat it as a configuration issue (protection function switched off) and have the installer review it.
solutions.ur: Agar warning roz aaye to ise configuration masla samajhein (protection function band) aur installer se review karwayein.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED red: critical status, no feed-in
title.ur: Operating LED laal: critical status, feed-in nahi

meaning.en: The inverter displays a critical status and no energy is fed into the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter critical status dikha raha hai aur grid mein koi energy feed nahi ho rahi.

causes.en: A critical state code is latched - e.g. WSD Open (1030) or a grid protection trip.
causes.ur: Critical state code latched hai - jaise WSD khula (1030) ya grid protection trip.

causes.en: The surge protection device has tripped, which on this model line lights the operating status LED red and raises 1030.
causes.ur: Surge protection device trigger hua hai, jo is model line par operating status LED laal karta hai aur 1030 deta hai.

solutions.en: Read the state code from System > Event Log or Solar.web first; do not open the inverter on the strength of the LED colour alone.
solutions.ur: Pehle System > Event Log ya Solar.web se state code padhein; sirf LED ke rang ke bharose par inverter na kholein.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and the DC disconnector and confirm de-energised with a suitable measuring device before any work.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC disconnector off karein aur koi bhi kaam karne se pehle suitable measuring device se de-energised confirm karein.

solutions.en: Fronius states that if the SPD caused it, the inverter must be repaired by an authorised specialist company.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai ke agar SPD ne cause kiya hai to inverter ki repair authorised specialist company se karwayein.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Operating LED red flashing: backup power overload
title.ur: Operating LED laal flash: backup power overload

meaning.en: The inverter displays a backup power overload; the maximum power in backup power mode from the technical data must be observed.
meaning.ur: Inverter backup power overload dikha raha hai; technical data mein di hui backup power mode ki maximum power ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Connected loads exceed the inverter's maximum backup power output on this three-phase unit.
causes.ur: Is three-phase unit par connected loads inverter ki maximum backup power se zyada hain.

causes.en: A large three-phase motor or heater with high inrush current was switched on in the backup circuit.
causes.ur: Backup circuit mein koi bara three-phase motor ya heater on kiya gaya jiska inrush current zyada hai.

solutions.en: Identify the load that came on when the LED started flashing and shed the largest loads one at a time.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke LED flash hone ke waqt kaunsa load on hua aur sab se bade loads aik aik kar ke hatayein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured backup power with the maximum backup power listed in the technical data for your Symo GEN24 size before re-enabling the load.
solutions.ur: Apne Symo GEN24 size ki technical data mein likhi maximum backup power se measured backup power milayein, load wapas on karne se pehle.

solutions.en: Wait for backup power operation to restart after the load has been reduced; an overload stops backup power mode on this model line too.
solutions.ur: Load kam karne ke baad backup power operation ke restart ka intezaar karein; is model line par bhi overload backup power mode rok deta hai.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED green 2x: WPS search mode
title.ur: Communication LED hara 2 baar: WPS search mode

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via WPS (2 flashes = WPS search mode).
meaning.ur: Network connection WPS ke zariye establish ho raha hai (2 flash = WPS search mode).

causes.en: WPS pairing was started from the inverter or the Fronius Solar.start app.
causes.ur: Inverter ya Fronius Solar.start app se WPS pairing shuru ki gayi.

solutions.en: Cancel an unintended WPS session on the router rather than leaving the inverter searching.
solutions.ur: Router par anjaani WPS session cancel karein, inverter ko search karte na chhodein.

solutions.en: If WPS keeps failing, commission over the WLAN access point in the Fronius Solar.start app or browser instead.
solutions.ur: Agar WPS baar baar fail ho to Fronius Solar.start app ya browser mein WLAN access point ke zariye commissioning karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes green twice (WPS search mode)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED blue 1x: WLAN access point search
title.ur: Communication LED neela 1 baar: WLAN access point search

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via WiFi access point; 1 flash = WiFi AP search mode, active for 30 minutes.
meaning.ur: Network connection WiFi access point ke zariye establish ho raha hai; 1 flash = WiFi AP search mode, 30 minute ke liye active.

causes.en: The optical sensor was touched once, opening the WiFi access point for commissioning.
causes.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chhua gaya, jis se commissioning ke liye WiFi access point khul gaya.

solutions.en: Join the 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network (key 12345678) and open the local user interface at the commissioning IP to finish setup.
solutions.ur: 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network (key 12345678) se connect hoke commissioning IP par local user interface kholein aur setup poora karein.

solutions.en: Note the access point closes itself after 30 minutes; touch the sensor again to reopen it.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke access point 30 minute baad khud band ho jata hai; dobara kholne ke liye sensor phir chhoonein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes blue once (WiFi AP search mode, active 30 min)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED yellow: network not configured
title.ur: Communication LED peela: network configure nahi

meaning.en: The network connection is not configured.
meaning.ur: Network connection configure nahi hua hai.

causes.en: Commissioning finished without configuring Communication > Network.
causes.ur: Commissioning Communication > Network configure kiye baghair poori ki gayi.

causes.en: The communication module was replaced and the network settings were lost.
causes.ur: Communication module badal diya gaya aur network settings kho gayin.

solutions.en: Touch the optical sensor once and complete network setup in the Fronius Solar.start app.
solutions.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chha kar Fronius Solar.start app mein network setup poora karein.

solutions.en: Use Automatic (DHCP) unless the site requires static addressing; if static, ask the network administrator for the address, subnet and gateway.
solutions.ur: Jab tak site ko static addressing ki zaroorat na ho, Automatic (DHCP) istemal karein; static ho to network administrator se address, subnet aur gateway poochein.

solutions.en: Save and confirm the Communication LED turns green or blue, meaning the network connection is active.
solutions.ur: Save karein aur confirm karein ke Communication LED hara ya neela ho gaya, matlab network connection active hai.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED red: network error, PV running
title.ur: Communication LED laal: network error, PV chal raha hai

meaning.en: There is a network error while the inverter is operating correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter sahi chal raha hai lekin network error hai.

causes.en: The inverter lost its network path (router, LAN1 cable or switch).
causes.ur: Inverter ka network path toot gaya (router, LAN1 cable ya switch).

causes.en: The router was replaced and the inverter still holds the previous static settings.
causes.ur: Router badal diya gaya aur inverter ke paas abhi bhi purani static settings hain.

solutions.en: Production is unaffected - check LAN1 cable, switch port and router power before touching anything on the DC side.
solutions.ur: Production par asar nahi - DC side chhoone se pehle LAN1 cable, switch port aur router power check karein.

solutions.en: Set Communication > Network to Automatic so a new address is assigned, then confirm the inverter returns to Solar.web.
solutions.ur: Communication > Network ko Automatic par set karein taake naya address mile, phir confirm karein ke inverter Solar.web par wapas aa gaya.

solutions.en: If it does not recover, power-cycle the router and check the inverter's internet services state under Communication.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas na aaye to router ka power cycle karein aur Communication mein inverter ki internet services state check karein.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED blue: network connection active
title.ur: Communication LED neela: network connection active

meaning.en: The network connection is active. This row exists only in the Symo GEN24 LED table.
meaning.ur: Network connection active hai. Ye row sirf Symo GEN24 LED table mein mojood hai.

causes.en: The inverter is connected and communicating over the network.
causes.ur: Inverter network se connected hai aur communicate kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Nothing to do - this is the healthy connected state on this model line.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi - is model line par ye healthy connected state hai.

solutions.en: If Solar.web shows the system offline despite this LED, check that the system was registered to your Fronius account and that contacts for notifications are set.
solutions.ur: Agar ye LED on ke bawajood Solar.web system offline dikhaye to check karein ke system aapke Fronius account par register hai aur notifications ke liye contacts set hain.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED flashing blue: update running
title.ur: Communication LED flash neela: update chal raha hai

meaning.en: The inverter is performing an update (firmware update in progress). This row exists only in the Symo GEN24 LED table.
meaning.ur: Inverter update kar raha hai (firmware update chal raha hai). Ye row sirf Symo GEN24 LED table mein mojood hai.

causes.en: An inverter firmware update started locally or remotely via Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter firmware update locally ya Solar.web se remotely shuru hui.

solutions.en: Do not interrupt the power supply during the update - Fronius states this explicitly for Solar.web updates.
solutions.ur: Update ke dauran power supply na kaatein - Fronius ye Solar.web updates ke liye saaf likhta hai.

solutions.en: After the update finishes, confirm the firmware version in Solar.web under Settings > Components.
solutions.ur: Update khatam hone ke baad Solar.web mein Settings > Components mein firmware version confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the update stops midway and the LED keeps flashing, do not power-cycle immediately; note the state and re-check via Solar.web before intervening.
solutions.ur: Agar update beech mein ruk jaye aur LED flash karta rahe to foran power cycle na karein; state note karein aur intervene karne se pehle Solar.web se dobara check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes blue (update in progress)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

title.en: Communication LED white: service message present
title.ur: Communication LED safed: service message maujood

meaning.en: There is a service message waiting. This row exists only in the Symo GEN24 LED table.
meaning.ur: Aik service message mojood hai. Ye row sirf Symo GEN24 LED table mein mojood hai.

causes.en: A state code / service message has been raised and not yet acknowledged on the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter par aik state code ya service message aaya hai jo abhi acknowledge nahi hua.

causes.en: The message is a normal operating message (e.g. after a restart or a settings change) rather than a fault.
causes.ur: Message normal operating message bhi ho sakta hai (jaise restart ya settings change ke baad) fault nahi.

solutions.en: Open the user interface (System > Event Log or the Notifications user menu) or Solar.web and read the message before acknowledging it.
solutions.ur: User interface (System > Event Log ya Notifications user menu) ya Solar.web kholein aur acknowledge karne se pehle message padhein.

solutions.en: Record the code and timestamp, then clear the message - on GEN24 the 3-second optical-sensor press acknowledges a service message (white rapid flash).
solutions.ur: Code aur timestamp note karein, phir message clear karein - GEN24 par optical sensor ko 3 second dabane se service message acknowledge hota hai (safed rapid flash).

solutions.en: If the white LED returns immediately, the message is being re-raised - treat the underlying code, not the LED, as the fault.
solutions.ur: Agar safed LED foran wapas aa jaye to message dobara raise ho raha hai - fault LED nahi, uske neeche wala code hai.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions
